QuestInfo.name: [Riena Strait] I Should Buy a Boat
QuestInfo.1: #b#p1510000##k in #b#m141000000##k told you that you'd need a boat to get around the area. Talk to #b#p1510005##k about getting a boat.
QuestInfo.2: You talked to #b#p1510005##k about a boat. Maybe you should get one.

0.0: These furry people are the #bMalamutes#k. They are not much for the talking. The blue ones are #bSeals#k. They have eyes like glass, and I do not trust them. That is why we must solve glacier problem. We will let our peoples go to separate ways again.
0.1: So... This is first time to #bRiena Strait#k, yes? Have you gone #bsailing#k before?
0.2: You will need a #bship#k to navigate the waters. Do you see seal over there? He manages many ships. Ask him for one.

yes.0: You talk to seal with foolish face. Get mighty boat!\r\n#b#b#e(Ask #p1510005# for a ship.)#k

no.0: You will not get far without ship or flippers.

yes.0: Are ya lookin' for a ship? Don't see why else ya'd come to me.

npc.0: You talk to seal with foolish face. Get mighty boat!\r\n#b#b#e(Ask #p1510005# for a ship.)#k
